Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FIRST KEYFRAME of a short illustrated Warcraft duel animation for a website, a single complete scene, not character stickers.
Input image 1: reference for Arthas identity, face, hair, armor and Frostmourne. Input image 2: reference for Illidan identity, horns, wings, warglaives and tattoos. These are identity references, not a pose to copy.
Create frame 01: ANTICIPATION. Arthas on the LEFT and Illidan on the RIGHT, facing each other across a narrow gap on a dark weathered stone floor. Both figures shown full-body, planted feet and strong contact shadows. Arthas holds Frostmourne low diagonally in front of him in a two-handed grip, knees bent preparing a rising strike. Illidan leans forward with one crescent warglaive guarding his chest and the other low by his side, knees bent, folded dark wings; both blades unambiguously connected to his hands. Neither weapon touching yet.
LOCKED CAMERA: landscape 3:2 aspect, eye-level medium-wide shot, both characters and all weapon tips inside frame, Arthas face around 30% width/30% height, Illidan face around 70% width/30% height; both feet around 83% height. Keep the upper 12% and lower 10% subdued empty dark space. This camera must work unchanged in all subsequent animation frames.
Backdrop: one continuous nearly-black cold stone chamber fading to black near all canvas edges, low floor mist, restrained blue light on left and green on right. Shared floor, reflected light, shadows, atmospheric depth integrate characters into ONE painting, no outline/glow cutout halos, no visible rectangular portrait boxes.
Style: accomplished classic Warcraft cinematic matte illustration, painterly realism, heavy weathered armor and sharp believable anatomy, not glossy AI-plastic. Preserve recognizable faces and weapon silhouettes from references. Fine facial details and hands; dramatic but controlled lighting.
Constraints: exactly two characters, each two arms/two hands, only Frostmourne for Arthas and two warglaives for Illidan; no duplicated limbs, no detached weapons, no combat injury, no text or logos or panels or montage, no UI. Opaque full scene, not transparent. One frame only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full-scene keyframe in an illustrated Warcraft duel animation. Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET and animation identity/camera/background anchor. Output a single new animation frame, NOT a storyboard, collage or side-by-side panels. Preserve the SAME Arthas on the left and Illidan on the right, faces, armor details, hair, tattoos, wings, weapons, scale, all floor stones and architecture, perspective, lighting and color grading. The camera must stay exactly fixed: no zoom, pan, crop, portrait rotation or background redraw. Landscape3:2 same as reference. Change only the two fighters' articulated poses and the small action-specific effects requested. Full bodies stay in frame, grounded planted feet and contact shadows, shared floor reflection. Match the reference's detailed painterly Warcraft cinematic realism. No labels, text, logos or watermarks. No cutout sticker outlines. Anatomically correct two arms/two hands per person. Arthas has exactly one Frostmourne; Illidan exactly two crescent warglaives. No duplicated or disconnected weapons/hands. 
Frame 02, WIND-UP: Change the actual articulated anatomy, not just object placement. Arthas coils his torso clockwise, bending his elbows and drawing Frostmourne back near his left hip with its tip behind him to the far left, preparing a rising diagonal cut to the right. His front knee bends further, white hair and cloak lag behind. Illidan lifts his near-side crescent glaive diagonally across the front of his upper chest to parry; his elbow bends, shoulders turn, legs brace. His second glaive remains low behind him. Weapons not yet touching.
